description.value: Fu Wah Express is a Chinese takeout restaurant on Goldstream Avenue offering a broad menu of classic Chinese-Canadian dishes spanning chow mein, chop suey, fried rice, Szechuan specialties, soups, and appetizers. Online pickup ordering is available with a stated 15-minute turnaround, making it a practical quick stop for cyclists in the Langford corridor. The menu includes a dedicated vegetarian section as well as vegan-labelled items.
